reason: The official NJIT repository abstract describes a wearable construction assistant that streams audio/vision to cloud LLM/RAG for guidance; it is an application system and reports no LLM inference-efficiency method.
title: Talk, See, Support (TSS): A Wearable Multimodal, Intelligent, Agentic LLM-Powered Construction Assistant for Real-Time On-Site Guidance and Compliance Monitoring
